[[File:ActionVITransport-SWR.png|thumb|200px|A bulk transport]]
'''Bulk transports''' were large [[Starship/Legends|starships]] designed to carry far greater quantities of cargo than light [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. Notable bulk freighters included the [[Action series/Legends|Action series]] transports. Bulk transports saw heavy use with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as supply ships and troop ships.

==Behind the scenes==
The bulk transport was featured as a ship in the PC strategy game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]. During an in-game video of the Rebel invasion of Coruscant, the Bulk transport can be seen literally filling the sky along side the rest of the Rebel Alliance Fleet.
